name: Neksin Connector
author: Neksin

sections.description:
Neksin Connector allows you to create and manage internal links automatically from the Neksin interface.

What is Neksin?

Neksin is a SaaS platform for managing internal linking (SEO mesh) on WordPress sites. This plugin acts as a secure connector between your site and the Neksin platform.

Maximum Security:

  • ✅ API key authentication (timing-safe comparison)
  • ✅ Rate limiting (20 requests/minute)
  • ✅ CORS restricted to Neksin domains
  • ✅ No custom attributes on links
  • ✅ Only internal links allowed
  • ✅ No SQL injection possible
  • ✅ Compatible with Wordfence, SecuPress, iThemes Security

Features:

  • Create clean internal links (<a href> tags only)
  • Remove links
  • Detect existing internal linking
  • Content extraction for AI anchor suggestion
  • Compatible with Gutenberg, Elementor, Divi, WP Bakery, WooCommerce, Beaver Builder, Oxygen, Brizy, Thrive Architect

What the plugin does:

  • Adds <a href> tags around existing text
  • Extracts text content for AI anchor suggestions
  • That’s it. Nothing more.

What the plugin does NOT do:

  • No data-* or custom attributes
  • No text modification
  • No scripts or tracking
  • No access to other WordPress tables
  • No external requests except to Neksin API (with your consent)

Third-Party Service

This plugin connects to the Neksin service (https://neksin.com) to:

  • Verify API credentials
  • Receive link creation/deletion commands
  • Send page content for AI anchor suggestions

By installing and activating this plugin, you agree to Neksin’s Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.

Privacy Policy

This plugin connects to external servers:

  • Neksin API (https://api.neksin.com) for receiving link commands
  • Your page content may be sent to Neksin for AI anchor suggestions

No personal user data is collected or transmitted. Only page content (title, text, headings) is sent when explicitly requested through the Neksin interface.

For more information, see Neksin’s Privacy Policy.

Disclaimer

This plugin is provided “AS IS” without warranty of any kind, either expressed or implied, including, but not limited to, the implied warranties of merchantability and fitness for a particular purpose.

USE AT YOUR OWN RISK

This plugin modifies your WordPress content (post_content field and _elementor_data for Elementor pages) to add or remove HTML link tags. While the plugin has been extensively tested with major page builders (Elementor, Divi, WPBakery, Beaver Builder, Oxygen, Brizy, Thrive Architect) and WordPress configurations, the vast variety of themes, plugins, and hosting environments makes it impossible to test every possible scenario.

  • Data being rendered inaccurate

  • Page display or rendering issues
  • Conflicts with themes or other plugins
  • Website downtime or service interruptions
  • Any other software, hardware, or business failures

STRONG RECOMMENDATIONS:

  1. BACKUP YOUR DATABASE before using this plugin, especially before any bulk link operations.
  2. TEST IN STAGING environment before deploying to production.
  3. KEEP BACKUPS of your WordPress installation at all times.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/neksin-connector/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Settings → Neksin Connector
  4. Enter your Neksin API key (get one at https://neksin.com)
sections.faq:
Is it compatible with my security plugin?

Yes. The plugin uses standard WordPress APIs and does not bypass any security measures.

What data is modified?

Only post content (post_content) to add/remove <a href> tags. For Elementor pages, the plugin also modifies _elementor_data to ensure link persistence.

Does the plugin access other tables?

No. It only uses its own table (wp_neksin_links) and native WordPress functions to read posts.

How does anchor suggestion work?

The plugin extracts text content from your pages and sends it to Neksin, which uses ChatGPT to suggest the best SEO anchors. Content is limited to 23,000 characters.

Is my content safe?

Yes. The plugin creates automatic backups before any modification (especially for Elementor). Content sent to Neksin is used only for anchor suggestions and is not stored permanently.

What happens if there’s a conflict with my theme?

The plugin has been tested with major page builders (Elementor, Divi, WPBakery, Beaver Builder, etc.). If you experience issues, please contact support.
